citation: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS). Station 9635002 — Puerto Santo Tomás de Castilla, Guatemala: Water Levels and Tides. NOAA Tides & Currents.
title: Sea level — Puerto Santo Tomás de Castilla (Station 9635002)
description: Water-level / tide observations from NOAA CO-OPS Station 9635002 at Puerto Santo Tomás de Castilla, Guatemala — the closest CO-OPS station serving as the regional sea-level reference for Belize's Caribbean coast. Mean range ~0.15–0.30 m per reference/summary.md §4; supports three IPCC AR6 SLR scenarios (low / intermediate / high) in the project's coastal model.
